label: verify-bm-formlabs-all-resins

claims.claim: Flexible 80A V2 gains +8% mass/+3% volume at 1 day in deionized water and +9%/+7% at 1 week; it is the only current resin with swelling large enough to contradict a blanket under-1%-in-24h statement.
claims.source_says: Deionized Water 1 day -26 +8% +3% 94% 89%; 1 week -27 +9% +7% 101% 88% (hardness change, mass, volume, elongation, tensile strength).
claims.note: Numbers reproduce from the TDS ASTM D471 table; 'only resin' is the agent's inference from the cube table (all other rows at or below 0.9%), which holds for the cube test but is not a different test.

claims.claim: Every other Form 4-family resin gains 0.0-0.9% mass in water in Formlabs's 24 h cube test (Clear V5 0.9, Tough 1000 0.0, Rigid 10K <0.1); no humid-air swelling or diffusivity data exists for any of them.
claims.source_says: Clear Resin V5 water 0.9; Tough 1000 Resin water 0; Rigid 10K Resin water <0.1; other rows seen 0.1-0.8 (some marked '<1' or not tested).
claims.note: The cube-table values reproduce, but some rows use '<1' and the 'no humid-air data exists' part is a negative I could not confirm from the page.

claims.claim: Elastic/Flexible 50A takes 39.2% IPA in 24 h against under 0.1% for Rigid 10K.
claims.source_says: Elastic 50A Resin V2 IPA 39.2 (24 hr weight gain, %); Rigid 10K Resin IPA <0.1.
claims.note: Both values match the solvent-compatibility table; 'largest contrast among same-chemistry Form 4 resins' is a mild superlative, and Flex 80A V1 (11.7) and others are smaller.

claims.claim: All Form 4 SLA resins except Silicone 40A are (meth)acrylate photopolymers per their SDS; Silicone 40A is polysiloxane; no measured bond strength exists in the sources read.
claims.source_says: Flexible 80A V2 SDS: Methacrylate monomer(s) 25-40. Silicone 40A SDS: Polysiloxane crosslinker 5-10, odor 'Characteristic acrylate'. Rigid 10K: Urethane Dimethacrylate 15-25.
claims.note: The 14 SDS I checked (not all Form 4 resins) all list (meth)acrylates except Silicone 40A, which lists a polysiloxane crosslinker and also has an acrylate odor line, so 'all' is extrapolated and the no-bonding-evidence part is a negative.

overall: The numbers hold up. The Flexible 80A V2 water-swelling figures, the cube-table water values and the 39.2% vs <0.1% IPA contrast all match the originals. Two claims are weaker as written. The "all Form 4 resins" chemistry claim is extrapolated from the 18 SDS fetched (14 resin SDS checked). The "no humid-air or diffusivity data exists" claim is a negative I could not confirm.
